strict_supported_stand.definition: pelvis>=0.60 m, torso tilt<=26 deg, BOTH feet contact force>10 N and feet<0.15 m above floor, pelvis speed<0.6 m/s, held 2 s

plausibility.definition: PLAUSIBLE recovery = strict supported stand held 2 s AND joint-velocity-limit violations on <=2% of steps AND peak pelvis upward speed <=2.0 m/s
plausibility.v21_definition: v2 AND past-hard-limit on <=3% of steps AND hard excess <=0.10 rad
plausibility.v2_definition: strict supported stand (3D speed<0.6) 2 s AND vel-viol<=2% AND flight<=2% AND peak vz<=2.0 AND pos-limit-viol<=10% AND no assist force applied
plausibility.v1p1_definition: POST-HOC amendment (added after seeing A8c): plausible AND free-flight (no body in contact with anything) on <=2% of steps

amendment3.status: Approved 2026-11-07: criteria v3 = v2.1 + 3a torque + 3c persistence + 3d stance here, and 3b self-penetration offline (selfpen_check.py). A v3 pass needs plausible_v3_before_selfpen and 3b.
